def factor_stress_adjusted_calm_intraday(df):
    """Calm intraday stability attenuated by accumulated overnight downside stress."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    theta = np.arctan(intraday_ret * 10)
    window = 20
    cos_mean = np.cos(theta).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    overnight_stress = overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).abs().rolling(window, min_periods=5).sum()
    stress_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + overnight_stress * 10.0)
    factor = cos_mean * stress_weight
    factor.name = "factor_stress_adjusted_calm_intraday"
    return factor
description: Mutation by ablation: removes the directional sign and angular resultant components, retaining only the positive intraday stability signal (rolling mean of cos(theta)). The parent's direction_sign injected sign flips that dilute top-quantile payoff by mixing high-stability names with negative mean theta into the top bucket; removing it promotes monotonic attribution of high factor to low magnitude/calm intraday behavior. The overnight stress attenuation is kept as a lightweight regime modifier to reduce exposure to overnight fragility. Parent strength target: RankICIR=0.4736 and long_short_sharpe=3.54. Bottleneck targeted: top-quantile annualized excess return and top-quantile excess percentile.
